textRuns.value: RECOMMENDATION FOR THE $250,000 TODAY: (1) Liquidity first - JSV's filed FY2025 cash is 0.46 months vs the 3.0-month floor, so if this cash is not already reserved for operations, bucket 1 outranks all four choices. (2) If it is truly investable, the strongest risk-adjusted use on the board's own numbers is paying down 7.00% debt: a contractual 17,500/yr that no market instrument matches today. (3) Stocks at 5.50% net clear the hurdle with market risk; T-bills at 4.13% are a MAYBE - a fine place to park while deciding. (4) The program is a mission decision - run the pilot rule; the partnership cannot be scored until a term sheet exists.
